L=1 load keeps the mirror pole >150MHz. The large-area L=2 input pair limits flicker noise. Class-A output swing reaches about VDD-0.4V."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15, 10, 20),        # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),     # input pair L (large area -> low flicker)
    "Itail": (24e-6, 12e-6, 60e-6),
    "Cc":    (2.2e-12, 1.0e-12, 4e-12),
    "I6":    (66e-6, 30e-6, 150e-6),
    "gmid6": (10, 7, 14),
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # NMOS bias mirrors L
    "rzk":   (1.6, 0.8, 3.0),     # Rz = rzk*(1+CL/Cc)/gm6 scaling
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2
    gmidb, Lb = 10.0, p["Lb"]
    # NMOS bias: diode reference and mirrors (same L, gm/Id)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, Iref, vds=0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, It, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, I6, vds=0.9)
    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", 9.0, 1.0, I1, vds=0.8)
    # second stage PMOS CS (Vsg ~ matches mirror)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], 1.0, I6, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rzk"] * (1 + CL / Cc) / m6.gm / 1.0
    Rz = max(Rz, 1.0 / m6.gm * 1.2)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M8", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.R("Rz", "vout", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "nz", "n1", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    C2 = CL + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)) / (2 * PI)
    p3 = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd) / (2 * PI)
    zden = Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    if zden > 0:
        z = 1 / (2 * PI * zden)
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
        p4 = 1 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)  # pole from Rz
        pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p4))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    swing = 1.62 - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * m1.gm) * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm)) * 3.0  # x3 rough flicker allowance
    power = 1.8 * (Iref + It + I6)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise, "power": power}
